slices.focus: Building a make-ahead freezer meal system after helping brother test dumpling fillings, to reduce evening stress during shipping-heavy weeks
slices.summary: After a video call testing dumpling fillings with her brother Evan (culinary school), Hannah plans a freezer-friendly make-ahead meal system — dumplings, soup, and baked pasta — to reduce bad dinner decisions during shipping-heavy weeks.
open_loops: One batch dumplings and one pot of soup as starting test
Friday-night-trigger rule: table still covered with work = weekend freezer reset
Write down successful filling ratios so next round doesn't depend on memory
decisions: Hannah has recently become attached to make-ahead dumplings and other freezer-friendly comfort meals to get through ship
